text: Late rate went up by 4 pp between 2017-07 and 2017-08. The largest contribution came from SP (3 pp). The second largest contribution came from RJ (1 pp). Late rate is defined as: Share of orders delivered after the estimated date The logged rule for this change is late_delivery.
